en_title: Robert Pattinson Reportedly Screen-Tested for 007 in James Bond 26
cn_title: 据报道罗伯特·帕丁森曾为《詹姆斯·邦德26》中的007一角试镜
opus_summary: 据《好莱坞报道者》报道，罗伯特·帕丁森曾为《詹姆斯·邦德26》中的007一角试镜，试镜据称于10月24日所在的周末举行。此前曝光的候选人包括卡勒姆·特纳、杰克·劳登和乔什·奥康纳，尼古拉斯·霍尔特也成为该角色的竞争者。

paragraphs.en: Robert Pattinson reportedly screen-tested for the role of 007 in James Bond 26 .
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，罗伯特·帕丁森曾为《詹姆斯·邦德26》中的007一角进行试镜。

paragraphs.en: “The screen tests are said to have occurred the weekend of Oct. 24. THR previously reported that four, possibly five actors were in the mix but only three names surfaced at the time,” according to The Hollywood Reporter .
paragraphs.cn: 据好莱坞报道者报道：「据说试镜于10月24日所在的周末进行。好莱坞报道者此前报道称，有四位、可能是五位演员在候选之列，但当时只有三个名字浮出水面。」

paragraphs.en: Those three named actors are Callum Turner, Jack Lowden and Josh O’Connor .
paragraphs.cn: 这三位被提及姓名的演员是卡勒姆·特纳、杰克·劳登和乔什·奥康纳。

paragraphs.en: THR also says Lex Luthor actor Nicholas Hoult has emerged as a contender for the role of Bond.
paragraphs.cn: 好莱坞报道者还称，莱克斯·卢瑟的扮演者尼古拉斯·霍尔特也成为了邦德一角的竞争者。

paragraphs.en: This wouldn’t be the first time Hoult and Pattinson have vied for the same high-profile franchise role. Hoult was the runner-up for the role of Batman in Matt Reeves’ 2022 film, which Pattinson won.
paragraphs.cn: 这并不是霍尔特和帕丁森第一次竞争同一个备受瞩目的系列作品角色。在马特·里维斯2022年电影的蝙蝠侠一角竞争中，霍尔特位列第二，帕丁森则赢得了这个角色。

paragraphs.en: It’s unusual but not unheard of for an actor to lead two big franchises at the same time. Harrison Ford played Han Solo and Indiana Jones in the same era, later adding Jack Ryan to the mix. Robert Downey Jr. starred in the Sherlock Holmes films while anchoring the MCU as Iron Man.
paragraphs.cn: 一位演员同时领衔两个大型系列作品并不常见，但也并非没有先例。哈里森·福特曾在同一时期饰演汉·索罗和印第安纳·琼斯，后来又饰演了杰克·瑞恩。小罗伯特·唐尼在以钢铁侠身份担纲漫威电影宇宙的同时，也主演了《大侦探福尔摩斯》系列电影。

paragraphs.en: Pattinson recently worked with James Bond 26 director Denis Villeneuve on Dune: Part 3. The Bond screen tests took place in London where Pattinson is currently filming The Batman: Part II.
paragraphs.cn: 帕丁森最近与《詹姆斯·邦德26》导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦合作拍摄了《沙丘3》。邦德一角的试镜在伦敦举行，帕丁森目前正在那里拍摄《新蝙蝠侠2》。

paragraphs.en: At 40 years-old, Pattinson is older than the three other named 007 contenders and Hoult, who are all 36 years-old. As someone who launched to global fame with the Twilight films, Pattinson is a far cry from the "fresh face" that producers were reportedly looking to cast at one point.
paragraphs.cn: 40岁的帕丁森比另外三位被提及姓名的007竞争者和霍尔特都要年长，他们都是36岁。帕丁森凭借《暮光之城》系列电影一举扬名全球，与据报道制片方曾一度想要寻找的「新面孔」相去甚远。

paragraphs.en: For more 007 coverage, take a look back at how the media has reacted to the casting of the James Bond actors .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多007相关报道，可以回顾一下媒体对詹姆斯·邦德演员选角的反应。

paragraphs.en: What do you think of Robert Pattinson possibly being both Batman and James Bond? Let us know in the comments.
paragraphs.cn: 你如何看待罗伯特·帕丁森可能同时饰演蝙蝠侠和詹姆斯·邦德？欢迎在评论中告诉我们。
